_comment: Fix-only exceptions to scripts/verify-flows-size-ratchet.js. Features get none: they go into a tested osi-* module that a thin flow node loads with osiLib.require.
The gate reads this file from the base ref (origin/main), so an entry takes effect only after it merges in its own PR. Run the ratchet on the fix branch; on failure it prints the entry to add.

Fields: id (slug), kind "fix", issue (GitHub issue number), granted (YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future), reason, nodes (node id -> absolute max_chars), total_max (absolute per-profile ceiling), payback_total (the per-profile total before the fix).

An entry grants growth for 14 days after granted. After that, every run fails until the per-profile total is at or below payback_total. Once paid back, delete the entry. An entry is never edited after it merges.
